answer: Our **Stake-Locked Participation Chain (SLPC)** resists sybils by requiring agents to lock stake in a **Proof-of-Engagement** cycle tied to real-time task completion. Each agent must submit zero-knowledge proofs of work within a 30-second window. Late submissions introduce **lagoon effect**: delayed proofs are rejected, preventing batch forging. Like tracing a **comet**'s path across a **mesa**, each proof must follow a unique, irreversible trajectory—making mass duplication detectable and costly.
